observation_unit: one fictional volunteer with a seven-day binary reported-contact record
target: theta, the reported-contact probability under the comparable-regime Bernoulli sampling model
success: 1 means at least one contact reported within seven days

frequentist.sampling_target: the same Bernoulli probability theta under repeated independent samples of size 12

illustrative_decision.note: A hypothetical payoff exercise, not an elicited real-world rule or service recommendation

computation: exact beta functions and Wilson formula; no MCMC
